Subject: Personal Loan Application – Sharon Burgess

Dear Loan Officer,

My name is Sharon Burgess, and I am writing to apply for a personal loan. I am a 46-year-old registered nurse at Cedar Valley Hospital, where I have worked the evening shift since September 2023. I would like to request a loan to help cover my household and living expenses during a temporary period of reduced income, and I would welcome your guidance on the loan products, amounts, and terms available to me.

I want to be fully transparent about my current situation: my nursing license was suspended by the South Carolina Board of Nursing effective September 15, 2024, with reinstatement scheduled for March 14, 2025. As a result, I am currently on unpaid leave from Cedar Valley Hospital. I am actively completing an online RN refresher course, my appeal with the Board is pending, and I expect to return to full-time work once my license is reinstated in March 2025.

Despite this temporary interruption, I am in a strong financial position:

- I own a beachfront condo in Myrtle Beach, purchased for $180,000, which is fully renovated and insured under policy HOP-938274, and I expect $12,000 per year in rental income from the property.
- I hold a $100,000 investment in a diversified mutual fund.
- I maintain a savings account with Crestview Savings (account no. 0045879021).
- I have a consistent record of financial responsibility, including paying my rent on time every month throughout 2024.

My ongoing monthly obligations are: $1,300 in rent for my one-bedroom apartment on Oak Street, approximately $180 in utilities, $1,200 in alimony, and $800 in child support. I have two children, ages 12 and 9, who primarily reside with me.

Based on my assets, rental income, and expected return to full-time nursing employment in March 2025, I am confident in my ability to repay a personal loan. I would be happy to provide any documentation you require, including proof of employment, bank statements, investment records, property and insurance records, and details of my expected reinstatement date.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Sincerely,
Sharon Burgess
7022 Elizabeth Locks
Lake Kathryn, South Carolina 73682
